content: I have examined the test image, which displays distinct white, powdery patches on the surface of a mango leaf. This presentation is highly characteristic of a fungal disease. Based on the visual evidence, I will now consult a reference image for the most likely candidate to confirm the diagnosis. The most probable class is Powdery Mildew, as the symptoms align well with its typical appearance. Sooty Mould usually appears as a black, soot-like coating, Anthracnose typically causes dark, sunken lesions, and Die Back involves the death of twigs or branches starting from the tip, none of which match the primary symptoms seen here. I will use my single reference image view to confirm Powdery Mildew.
